license_required.quote: If any person who does not possess a valid license to practice medicine within this state and who is not exempted from the licensing requirements does any of the acts constituting the practice of medicine, he or she shall be deemed to be practicing medicine without complying with the provisions of the Arkansas Medical Practices Act

issuing_authority.quote: The Arkansas State Medical Board shall

name.quote: The Arkansas State Medical Board shall

age_minimum.quote: Is at least twenty-one (21) years of age

moral_character_required.quote: Has not been guilty of acts constituting unprofessional conduct

degree_required.value: Graduate of recognized United States or Canadian medical school, or foreign medical school approved by the Arkansas State Medical Board
degree_required.quote: Is a graduate of: A recognized United States or Canadian medical school whose entrance requirements and course of instruction have been approved by the Council on Medical Education of the American Medical Association; A Canadian eclectic medical school which has been approved by the Council on Medical Education of the National Eclectic Medical Association; or A foreign medical school whose entrance requirements and course of instruction have been approved by the Arkansas State Medical Board

accrediting_body.value: Council on Medical Education of the American Medical Association; National Eclectic Medical Association; Arkansas State Medical Board
accrediting_body.quote: approved by the Council on Medical Education of the American Medical Association

required.quote: Served three (3) years as an intern, resident, or fellow, or a combination thereof, in an accredited postgraduate medical education program in the United States

duration.value: 3 years for domestic graduates; 3 years for foreign graduates with additional requirements
duration.quote: Served three (3) years as an intern, resident, or fellow, or a combination thereof, in an accredited postgraduate medical education program in the United States; Served three (3) years as an intern or resident in a postgraduate medical education program outside the United States, completed all steps of the United States Medical Licensing Examination, obtained Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates certification, and either completed one (1) year or more of fellowship training accredited by the Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education in the United States or received American Board of Medical Specialties certification by the American Board of Medical Specialties; or Completed one (1) year as an intern or resident in an accredited postgraduate medical education program in the United States and be currently enrolled in an accredited postgraduate medical program in Arkansas

kind.value: postgraduate medical education program (internship, residency, or fellowship)
kind.quote: Served three (3) years as an intern, resident, or fellow, or a combination thereof, in an accredited postgraduate medical education program in the United States

exams.name: Examination approved by the Arkansas State Medical Board
exams.quote: Has successfully passed an examination approved by the Arkansas State Medical Board as set forth in its rules

interval_years.quote: The annual license or reregistration fee of a physician licensed by the Arkansas State Medical Board to practice medicine in the State of Arkansas shall be paid before or during the birth month of the license holder beginning in 1998, and each year thereafter

renewal_fee_usd.quote: For annual license or reregistration fee, seventy dollars ($70.00)

available.quote: A legally licensed physician and surgeon who has been issued a license to practice medicine in another state where the requirements for licensure are equal to those established by the State of Arkansas may be permitted by the Arkansas State Medical Board to practice his or her profession in this state without taking an examination upon payment of a fee

requirements.value: Requirements for licensure in other state must be equal to those established by Arkansas; issuance is at sole discretion of the board
requirements.quote: A legally licensed physician and surgeon who has been issued a license to practice medicine in another state where the requirements for licensure are equal to those established by the State of Arkansas may be permitted by the Arkansas State Medical Board to practice his or her profession in this state without taking an examination upon payment of a fee as provided in § 17-95-411. The issuance of a license by credentials by the board shall be at the sole discretion of the board

exists.quote: The Arkansas State Medical Board shall

national_association.value: American Medical Association; Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education; American Osteopathic Association
national_association.quote: approved by the Council on Medical Education of the American Medical Association; Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education, American Osteopathic Association

regulatory_model.quote: If any person who does not possess a valid license to practice medicine within this state and who is not exempted from the licensing requirements does any of the acts constituting the practice of medicine, he or she shall be deemed to be practicing medicine without complying with the provisions of the Arkansas Medical Practices Act

credential_type.quote: Every person who practices or attempts to practice medicine in any of its branches or who performs or attempts to perform any surgical operation for any person or upon any person within this state without first having complied with the provisions of the Arkansas Medical Practices Act, § 17-95-201 et seq., § 17-95-301 et seq., and § 17-95-401 et seq., shall be deemed guilty of a misdemeanor

is_mandatory.quote: If any person who does not possess a valid license to practice medicine within this state and who is not exempted from the licensing requirements does any of the acts constituting the practice of medicine, he or she shall be deemed to be practicing medicine without complying with the provisions of the Arkansas Medical Practices Act

title_protection.quote: Using the title "M.D.", "M.B.", "D.O.", "physician", "surgeon", or any other word or abbreviation to indicate or induce others to believe that one is engaged in the diagnosis or treatment of persons afflicted with disease, injury, or defect of body or mind, except as otherwise expressly permitted by the laws of this state relating to the practice of any limited field of the healing arts

scope_protection.quote: Holding out oneself to the public within this state as being able to diagnose, treat, prescribe for, palliate, or prevent any human disease, ailment, injury, deformity, or physical or mental condition, whether by the use of drugs, surgery, manipulation, electricity, or any physical, mechanical, or other means whatsoever

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony listed under § 17-3-102
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony listed under § 17-3-102. The judgment of any such conviction, unless pending upon appeal, shall be conclusive evidence of unprofessional conduct

disciplinary_grounds.description: Resorting to fraud, misrepresentation, or deception in applying for or securing a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Resorting to fraud, misrepresentation, or deception in applying for or securing a license to practice medicine, in taking the examination for the license, or in seeking a renewal of a license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting an unlicensed person to practice medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting an unlicensed person to practice medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Procuring or aiding or abetting in procuring a wrongful and criminal abortion
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Procuring or aiding or abetting in procuring a wrongful and criminal abortion

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of laws regulating possession, distribution, or use of narcotic or controlled drugs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of the laws of the United States or the State of Arkansas regulating the possession, distribution, or use of narcotic or controlled drugs classed in Schedules I-V of the Controlled Substances Act of 1970 or the Uniform Controlled Substances Act, § 5-64-101 et seq., including any amendments thereto

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual indulgence in alcohol use rendering the physician incapable of exercising proper skill and judgment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual indulgence in the use of alcohol to such an extent as to render himself or herself incapable of exercising that degree of skill and judgment in the treatment of his or her patients which the moral trust and confidence in him or her demands

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual, intemperate, or excessive use of narcotics or habit-forming drugs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual, intemperate, or excessive use of narcotics or of any other habit-forming drugs

disciplinary_grounds.description: Representing to a patient that a manifestly incurable condition can be permanently cured
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Representing to a patient that a manifestly incurable condition of sickness, disease, or injury can be permanently cured

disciplinary_grounds.description: Becoming physically or mentally incompetent to practice medicine to such an extent as to endanger the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Becoming physically or mentally incompetent to practice medicine to such an extent as to endanger the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Insanity or mental disease evidenced by adjudication, voluntary commitment, or examination by three impartial psychiatrists
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Insanity or mental disease, if evidenced by an adjudication or by voluntary commitment to an institution for treatment of a mental disease or as determined by an examination conducted by three (3) impartial psychiatrists retained by the Arkansas State Medical Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Soliciting for patronage or advertising in false, fraudulent, deceptive, or misleading manner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Soliciting for patronage; advertising for patronage in a false, fraudulent, deceptive, or misleading manner; advertising the quality of medical services; or advertising illegal procedures and practices

disciplinary_grounds.description: Offering to cure or treat disease by secret method or refusing to divulge method to the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Offering, undertaking, attempting, or agreeing to cure or treat disease by a secret method, procedure, treatment, or medicine or representing, directly or indirectly, that he or she can treat, operate on, or prescribe for any human condition by a method, means, or procedure which he or she refuses to divulge upon demand to the Arkansas State Medical Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful betraying of a professional secret
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The willful betraying of a professional secret

disciplinary_grounds.description: Persistent and flagrant overcharging or overtreating of patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Persistent and flagrant overcharging or overtreating of patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating a rule of the Arkansas State Medical Board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating a rule of the Arkansas State Medical Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating a term of probation or an order previously imposed by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating a term of probation or an order previously imposed by the Arkansas State Medical Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having been found in violation of a statute or rule governing medical practice by another state's licensing authority
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having been found in violation of a statute or a rule governing the practice of medicine by a medical licensing authority or agency of another state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing an ethical violation as determined by the Arkansas State Medical Board by rule
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing an ethical violation as determined by the Arkansas State Medical Board by rule

definition_quote.value: Holding out oneself to the public within this state as being able to diagnose, treat, prescribe for, palliate, or prevent any human disease, ailment, injury, deformity, or physical or mental condition, whether by the use of drugs, surgery, manipulation, electricity, or any physical, mechanical, or other means whatsoever; Suggesting, recommending, prescribing, or administering any form of treatment, operation, or healing for the intended palliation, relief, or cure of any physical or mental disease, ailment, injury, condition, or defect of any person with the intention of receiving, either directly or indirectly, any fee, gift, or compensation whatsoever; Maintaining an office or other place to meet persons for the purpose of examining or treating persons afflicted with disease, injury, or defect of body or mind; Using the title "M.D.", "M.B.", "D.O.", "physician", "surgeon", or any other word or abbreviation to indicate or induce others to believe that one is engaged in the diagnosis or treatment of persons afflicted with disease, injury, or defect of body or mind; Performing any kind of surgical operation upon a human being; or Delegating certain medical practices to other personnel under rules adopted by the board
definition_quote.quote: Holding out oneself to the public within this state as being able to diagnose, treat, prescribe for, palliate, or prevent any human disease, ailment, injury, deformity, or physical or mental condition, whether by the use of drugs, surgery, manipulation, electricity, or any physical, mechanical, or other means whatsoever

methods_authorized.quote: diagnose, treat, prescribe for, palliate, or prevent any human disease, ailment, injury, deformity, or physical or mental condition, whether by the use of drugs, surgery, manipulation, electricity, or any physical, mechanical, or other means whatsoever

drug_authority.value: Physicians may prescribe, dispense, and administer drugs including controlled substances subject to board rules and state/federal law
drug_authority.quote: Suggesting, recommending, prescribing, or administering any form of treatment, operation, or healing for the intended palliation, relief, or cure of any physical or mental disease, ailment, injury, condition, or defect of any person

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical school graduates must have entrance requirements and course of instruction approved by the Arkansas State Medical Board; must serve 3 years in postgraduate medical education program outside the United States, complete all steps of USMLE, obtain ECFMG certification, and either complete 1+ year of ACGME-accredited fellowship training or receive ABMS certification
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: A foreign medical school whose entrance requirements and course of instruction have been approved by the Arkansas State Medical Board... He or she must also have:... Served three (3) years as an intern or resident in a postgraduate medical education program outside the United States, completed all steps of the United States Medical Licensing Examination, obtained Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates certification, and either completed one (1) year or more of fellowship training accredited by the Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education in the United States or received American Board of Medical Specialties certification by the American Board of Medical Specialties

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: Served three (3) years as an intern, resident, or fellow, or a combination thereof, in an accredited postgraduate medical education program in the United States

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: A physician shall not be subject to disciplinary action solely for prescribing dangerous or controlled drugs for relief of chronic intractable pain; board may limit Schedule II narcotics by rule
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: Promulgate rules limiting the amount of Schedule II narcotics that may be prescribed and dispensed by licensees of the board.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: Physicians may prescribe through telemedicine if professional relationship established; audio-only technology may not be used to renew written certification; same standard of care applies as in-person
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: Once a professional relationship is established, a healthcare professional may provide healthcare services through telemedicine, including interactive audio, if the healthcare services are within the scope of practice for which the healthcare professional is licensed or certified... Healthcare services provided by telemedicine, including without limitation a prescription through telemedicine, shall be held to the same standard of care as healthcare services provided in person... "Telemedicine" does not include the use of audio-only electronic technology by a physician to renew a written certification that was previously issued to the same patient.

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: The Arkansas Medical Society, Inc. shall have the authority to establish a physicians' health committee

administrative_medicine_license_availabl.quote: The Arkansas State Medical Board may issue an academic license to practice medicine to any physician

investigational_drug_protection.quote: Administer a large dose of a dangerous or controlled drug even if its use may increase the risk of death if the purpose is not to cause or assist in a patient's death
